notes: REF-BM-03: editing works after save (edit drawer) but auto-collected title/description are not editable before save on the normal preview path (only a Save button); manual form is for unreachable pages only. REF-BM-04: edit updates title/description/note/tags but not url (updateBookmark ignores url; no url field in edit form). REF-BM-12: full-text search (matchesSearch) covers title/description/note only, url is not searched. REF-BM-14: no #tag search syntax in query parsing. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT/parentheses boolean parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling (plain substring includes). REF-BM-20: no multi-select/bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no apply-to-whole-filtered-collection action. REF-BM-22: no sort-key selection; list is fixed newest-first (unshift), no title/date sort control or API param. REF-BM-23: note is stored and displayed but rendered as escaped plain text, not markdown. REF-BM-24: preserves extracted readable text paragraphs as a copy, not a single-file HTML snapshot, and no PDF download rule. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive/Wayback integration. REF-BM-26: no archived flag; 'archive' here is a readable text copy, not a hide-from-list state. REF-BM-27: no archive-vs-delete distinction (only permanent delete). REF-BM-28: no archived-bookmarks list view. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no Netscape HTML export. REF-BM-32: no user/display settings (default sort, displayed items, font size).
